description: We are a team with a passion for space, science, and exploring new ideas. We enjoy researching information, acquiring new knowledge, and sharing creative concepts. Our goal is to work together to complete an engaging and informative project about the equipment left behind by NASA on the Moon and Mars. All we really want is to receive a certificate from NASA itself! And, of course, we would be thrilled if we were to win.
summary: A narrative and historical tribute to NASA's Mars rovers, Spirit and Opportunity. The project chronicles their multi-year exploration across Gusev Crater and Meridiani Planum, highlighting their endurance against harsh dust storms, their final transmissions, and their lasting legacy in planetary discovery.
details: What does it do? It provides a narrative and historical documentation of NASA's Mars rovers, Spirit and Opportunity, blending emotional storytelling with technical accuracy. Tools & Approach: Used historical mission data and records from NASA's Mars exploration program, structured into a compelling narrative format to engage the audience and judges.
